name: Fantasy: Location Establishing Clip
description: Video preset for a location clip in the Fantasy look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second establishing shot. State the camera move, time of day, and two things moving in the scene. Keep the architecture consistent with the entity.
context_prompt: short establishing clip of the location with one slow camera move and ambient life in the frame, epic fantasy concept painting, painterly brushwork, ornate hand-crafted armour and cloth, ancient architecture with real scale, golden light through mist, rich jewel-tone palette, volumetric god rays, atmospheric depth, sweeping aerial and crane moves, cloaks and banners in wind, drifting embers and motes of light
negative_prompt: modern clothing, guns, cars, sci-fi technology, photographic snapshot look, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
